title: Nicchavitthisuttaṃ
text: 214 . ‘‘Idhāhaṃ , āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ nicchaviṃ itthiṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ. Tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti. Sā sudaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karoti…pe… esā, bhikkhave, itthī imasmiṃyeva rājagahe aticārinī ahosi…pe…. Tatiyaṃ.
